title: TEST: deterministic test vectors (raw pictures, tiny golden streams, embedded arrays for the probe)
ios_note: This package has no iOS-compiled code, so it imports no system symbols and needs no symbols.txt; embedded_vectors.h is C11 that WP07 compiles into the probe.
done: vectors/gen_yuv.py: pure Python 3 CLI (--pattern gradient|squares|pan|static|noise|text --size WxH --frames N --format i420|nv12 --out FILE), byte-for-byte deterministic; exact integer definitions from the package; extra --ppm/--ppm-frame helper with BT.601 full-range integer conversion (1436/352/731/1815 scaled by 1/1024, clamp) used for the golden JPEG/HEIC.

vectors/make_vectors.sh [quick|full|clean] (+ make_vectors.py): writes vectors/data and manifest.json; quick = 176x144 x10 for all six patterns, 178x146 x10 squares, 640x480 x10 squares and pan (11.34 MiB raw); full adds 1280x720 x10 squares, 1920x1080 x4 pan, 1918x1078 x4 text (38.67 MiB more). Data is git-ignored and deletable.

Six golden streams from squares 176x144, 8 frames: H.264 Constrained Baseline Annex B (x264 0.165.3222, keyint 8, no B, QP 28, ref 1); H.264 High CABAC+B (trace_headers: profile_idc 100, entropy_coding_mode_flag 1, has_b_frames 2); HEVC Main no B (x265 4.3, preset fast, QP 30, keyint 8); JPEG q85 (cjpeg/libjpeg-turbo 3.2.1); HEIC (heif-enc/libheif 1.23.7); AV1 2 frames (aomenc 3.15.3, --limit=2 --cpu-used=8, IVF).

vectors/manifest.json version 1: raw[] with pattern/width/height/frames/format/path/sha256 and streams[] with codec/profile/width/height/frames/path/sha256/made_with (exact commands + tool versions)/frame_md5[]/luma_md5_first_frame/frame_md5_normative; paths relative to vectors/data; stream_sources[] records the 8-frame source.

vectors/make_embedded.py -> vectors/embedded_vectors.h: H.264 SPS+PPS and HEVC VPS+SPS+PPS separately without start codes; each access unit converted to AVCC with 4-byte big-endian lengths and parameter-set/AUD/filler NALs removed (SEI kept); struct n2vec_frame tables and keyframe flags; generic struct n2vec_stream/n2vec_image tables plus explicit named arrays; width/height/frame counts; golden luma md5 strings; JPEG/HEIC whole files; include guard, all static const; static inline n2vec_count() = 4, n2vec_stream_count() = 2, n2vec_image_count() = 2. Data total 12618 bytes (limit 49152).

The conversion is verified in make_embedded.py by converting every AVCC access unit back to NAL units and comparing with the Annex-B original minus parameter sets/AUD, and check_vectors.sh additionally reconstructs Annex B from the header, decodes it with ffmpeg, and compares frame count and frame-0 luma md5.

vectors/check_vectors.sh: regenerates quick into a temporary directory, requires the manifest to be byte-identical, checks every raw sha256 (and exact size), every stream sha256, ffmpeg exit status, frame count, per-frame md5 and first-frame luma md5; compiles embedded_vectors.h with clang -Wall -Wextra -Werror in a file that includes it twice; dumps/decodes the embedded streams/images; regenerates the header and compares byte for byte; generates a second time and compares manifests; enforces du -sb vectors < 40000000. Exits 0 with N2TEST WP09 PASS 152/152.
vectors/run_tests.sh forwards to check_vectors.sh; vectors/README.md documents the CLI, the manifest and the probe interface; vectors/STATUS.json (this file).
deviations: heif-enc 1.23.7 (libheif) does not accept PPM input ('Not a JPEG file: starts with 0x50 0x36'), so the HEIC is made by converting the same PPM to a lossless PNG with ffmpeg and encoding that; both commands and tool versions are recorded in manifest streams[].made_with.
The work package defines luma only for the pan and static patterns; their chroma is neutral 128. Documented in gen_yuv.py, manifest notes and README.

x264 is given --ref 1 and --threads 1 in addition to the listed options (Baseline allows one reference; single-threaded output is deterministic); x265 adds --pools 1 --frame-threads 1 and aomenc --threads=1 for the same reason.

The quick set contains all six patterns at 176x144 but one pattern each at 178x146 and two at 640x480, to stay well inside the 40 MB directory cap; gen_yuv.py can make any pattern/size on demand for WP03/WP04/WP10. The full set is 50.95 MB and must be cleaned before the size acceptance check.

commands.cmd: cd gpu/video && bash vectors/make_vectors.sh quick --out build/WP09/tmp/data --manifest build/WP09/tmp/manifest.json
commands.last_line: make_vectors: wrote .../manifest.json: 9 raw sequences (11.34 MiB), 6 streams (15.89 KiB)
N2VEC wrote .../embedded_vectors.h: h264 8 AUs (9 NALs kept, 27 param bytes), hevc 8 AUs (9 NALs kept, 68 param bytes), total 12618 B (budget 49152)

known_risks: The manifest byte-identity check is deliberately sensitive to tool versions: a different x264/x265/cjpeg/heif-enc/aomenc/ffmpeg build changes stream bytes and will fail check_vectors.sh instead of silently accepting different vectors.

JPEG and HEIC frame_md5 values are decoder dependent; frame_md5_normative is false for them and the probe only checks their dimensions. H.264/HEVC/AV1 frame md5 are normative for 8-bit 4:2:0 and luma_md5_first_frame is what the probe compares.
fractional motion/chroma is not present in pan/static because the package defines luma only; if the lead wants chroma motion there, it must be specified and all hashes regenerated.
make_vectors.sh full writes ~51 MB into vectors/data, above the 40 MB directory cap; run 'make_vectors.sh clean' before measuring du. The committed state has no data (182356 bytes).
The H.264/HEVC access units keep SEI NAL units; a VideoToolbox sample buffer accepts them, but if the probe prefers parameter-set-only access units that is a one-line change in make_embedded.py.

pan, static, noise and text are deliberately high-frequency (the frozen definitions); WP10 measured that even x264 Constrained Baseline misses the plan's absolute PSNR floors at QP 40/51 on pan/noise (pan QP51 16.6-19.6 dB vs floor 22, noise QP51 13.4-16.2 dB vs 22). That is a property of the specified pictures, not of an encoder; the oracle floor rule needs the relative/QP<=32 change WP10 proposed. WP09 will not change the frozen patterns silently.
